problems.reason: Sentences 9 and 10 give conflicting Cretaceous stage classifications for Tapuiasaurus—one says Lower Cretaceous, the other says Middle Cretaceous, both for the Aptian age.

Sentences 7 and 8 present mutually exclusive phylogenetic positions: 7 places Tapuiasaurus as sister to Rapetosaurus within Nemegtosauridae, while 8 claims a distant connection to Nemegtosaurus and a close relationship with other Gondwanan lithostrotians.
Both sentences state that Tapuiasaurus lived during the Aptian age, repeating the same age claim.
